miniProject.title: Threat model, least-privilege tests, a privacy-bounded aggregate and a safe migration
miniProject.brief: Set the trust boundary of the service slice with a threat model, scoped expiring credentials, tenant isolation on every path, a hash-chained audit log and verified backups. Add one bounded private aggregate and a canary migration with rollback and revocation.
steps: Draw the system model with trust boundaries, data flows, stores, processes and external actors following the OWASP cheat sheet, list assets with an insider profile, and close each abuse case in a test or an explicit residual-risk sentence.

Issue per-client credentials carrying tenant, scopes and expiry under a server key, check signature, expiry and scope on the server clock with a stated skew allowance, and reject missing, forged, expired, out-of-scope and wrong-tenant callers with a separate logged admin path.

Scope every key and query by the authenticated tenant on the normal, retry, fallback and restore paths, keep the injection fixture that separates interpolated from parameterized queries, and never deserialize untrusted input.

Record authentication, scope and cross-tenant denials in a hash-chained audit log with redacted secrets, verify that tampering breaks the chain, deny when the policy cannot load, and verify backups by digest, counts, predicates and chain before serving, refusing corruption.

Release one clamped and noised aggregate with OpenDP from the usage data with stated unit, adjacency, sensitivity, \(\epsilon\) and \(\delta\) inputs and a ledgered budget, measure utility across repeated runs, and state what the guarantee leaves out.

Migrate records behind a canary that reads both versions and rolls back with every record still readable, practise the rollback once, then revoke a credential while the issuer is down and show cached revocation still denies.
deliverables: The threat model with abuse cases and residual risks, plus credential, isolation, injection and audit tests with their failing cases.
The backup and restore verification script that refuses corruption before serving.
The private release with parameters, ledger, utility measurements and residual-risk statement, and the migration drill with rollback and revocation.

rubric.pass: Every abuse case ends in a test or a residual-risk sentence, and forged, expired, out-of-scope and cross-tenant callers are rejected by tests.
rubric.strong: Tenant scope comes from the credential on every path, including retry, fallback and restore.

rubric.pass: Tampering breaks the audit chain with secrets redacted, and a corrupted backup is refused before serving.
rubric.strong: Restore checks predicates and the chain rather than digests alone.

rubric.pass: The release states unit, adjacency, sensitivity, budget and measured utility, the canary rolls back cleanly, and revocation holds during the outage.
rubric.strong: Residual risks name cases outside the guarantee, the ledger blocks over-budget release, and rollback fires from metrics.

miniProject.feedsInto: Capstone dossier: the threat model, least-privilege tests, migration with rollback and the bounded private aggregate with its limits.
